prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
A `#[repr(packed)]` type cannot transitively contain a `#[repr(align(...))]` type. This restriction applies to nested members as well.

Additionally:

- `#[repr(packed)]` and `#[repr(align(...))]` cannot be applied to the same type.
- A `#[repr(packed)]` type nested inside a `#[repr(align(...))]` type is allowed.
- `#[repr(packed)]` is equivalent to `#[repr(packed(1))]`.
- A packed type may have unaligned fields, so references to its fields cannot be created.
